scope: Independent read-only smooth-arc SVG verification and actual sharp raster visual inspection
renderer: Bundled Node sharp through Presentations rasterize_svg.mjs
direction_policy: No fixed-angle or one-degree acceptance criterion; verifies continuous standard half-ellipse geometry and attached orient=auto endpoint markers.
qa_correction_record: The first QA script treated marker height as only the markerHeight attribute. Inspection showed that the authorized triangle-height change also updates viewBox height, refY and the triangle coordinates. The final checks require those fields to agree exactly with the new height and unchanged width, then compare the entire remainder of the document to the backup. The initial diagnostic is retained in preview/svg/svg_acceptance_initial_scope_error.json.

figures.visual_observation: The rotation shafts appear as continuous smooth half-ellipse arcs without vertical terminal stems. Arrowheads are attached to the curve endpoints. Red/black coordinate labels, subscripts, frame geometry and straight arrows remain clear.
